name: Explore the 3D birthday landing and continue to the gallery
description: Verifies the birthday landing hero is visible, its primary action navigates to the photo gallery, and the layout remains usable on mobile.
steps: Open the birthday site on mobile
View the layered 3D hero and Veee portrait
expected: The 3D hero renders without horizontal overflow and the primary action scrolls to the photo gallery.

name: Reveal and hide the personal birthday letter
description: Verifies the birthday letter can be expanded and collapsed without leaving the page.
steps: Scroll to the personal note section
expected: The full birthday letter appears after the first click and is hidden again after the second click.

name: Respond to the playful birthday question
description: Verifies either playful answer produces a visible, matching response.
steps: Read the response beneath the buttons
expected: A playful follow-up message appears beneath the selected choices.

name: Keep the gallery and birthday letter readable on a narrow screen
description: Verifies the gallery, compliment cards, and personal letter remain readable on a narrow screen.
steps: Open the site at a mobile viewport
Scroll through the gallery and compliment cards
expected: Content stacks cleanly, images remain visible, and the page has no horizontal overflow.
